script: const sdk = require('postman-collection'); const url = new sdk.Url('https://x.example/a?b=1'); console.log(url.getHost(), url.query.get('b')); const h = new sdk.Header({key: 'A', value: '1'}); console.log(h.toString()); const list = new sdk.PropertyList(sdk.Header, null, [{key: 'X', value: 'y'}]); console.log(list.get('X')); const scope = new sdk.VariableScope({values: [{key: 'v', value: 1}]}); console.log(scope.get('v'), new sdk.Variable({key: 'k', value: 'v'}).toString()); const req = new sdk.Request({url: 'https://x.example', method: 'POST'}); console.log(req.method); const res = new sdk.Response({code: 200, body: '{}'}); console.log(res.code);
